headline: Why Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) Is Down 7.8% After Q2 2026 Results Reveal Mixed Credit Signals
summary: Huntington Bancshares recently reported its second-quarter 2026 results, showing higher net interest income of US$2,052 million and net income of US$727 million year over year, while also disclosing increased net charge-offs of US$119 million.
